title: Double Drip 10K Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Double Drip 10K Bundle offers a distinctive new format for enjoying the bold, flavourful Double Drip experience in a take-anywhere device. This exclusive bundle includes two complete Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pod Kits plus two additional Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pods. With four total 12ml e-liquid units included, this bundle provides an exceptional supply of hardware and e-liquid, perfect for vapers seeking a high-performance, low-maintenance solution. Each device features a powerful built-in 1100mAh battery—one of the largest in its class—paired with a smart auto-refill mechanism. The system combines a 2ml prefilled pod with a 10ml refill bottle, delivering up to 10,000 puffs per setup with no messy refills required. The sleek, metallic body includes a crisp LED digital display that shows puff count and battery life at a glance. Performance is driven by an integrated mesh coil that ensures consistent flavour production. For those seeking more intensity, the device features a 'Boost Mode' that delivers three times the power for a richer, more dynamic vape. This bundle combines smooth, satisfying performance with the convenience of a rechargeable system. How To Set Up Your Double Drip 10K Device Step 1 Remove all silicone bungs and protective stickers from the device, pod, and refill bottle before use. Step 2 Insert the refill bottle into the device as instructed. Step 3 Click the pod into place. Step 4 Allow the coil to saturate for a moment. Step 5 Inhale to vape. ✅ Ready to vape Double Drip 10K Kit Flavours • Banana Ice Smooth and mellow Banana paired with an icy Menthol finish for a cool, creamy vape. • Blue Razz Lemonade A zesty burst of Lemonade brightened by juicy Blue Raspberry for a tart, tangy blend. • Blueberry Sour Raspberry Deep, sweet Blueberry layered with sharp, tangy Sour Raspberry for a dynamic fruit mix. • Cherry Cola Classic Cola with a rich Cherry twist, offering sweet soda notes and fizzy tang. • Cherry Ice Juicy, dark Cherry balanced by a brisk wave of Menthol for a sharp and sweet finish. • Lemon & Lime A classic citrus duo delivering sharp, zesty Lemon with bright, vibrant Lime. • Pineapple Ice Juicy tropical Pineapple enhanced by a brisk Menthol lift. • Spearmint Menthol A cooling blend of crisp Menthol and delicately sweet Spearmint. • Strawberry Ice Sun-ripened Strawberry balanced with a clean Menthol chill. • Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice A triple berry medley lifted by a crisp, icy finish.
